description: Reconcile decision corpus: keeper/candidate pairs with expected outcomes. Adversarial families (negation, numbers, instead) must NEVER be silently skipped.

families.identical: byte-identical or trivially equal pairs -> skipped without LLM
families.paraphrase_close: near-duplicates expected at J>=0.60 -> auto-skip + corroborate, no LLM
families.paraphrase_loose: ambiguous overlap expected at J 0.30-0.60 -> LLM consulted
families.negation: contradictions via negation -> NEVER silently skipped
families.numbers: same wording, different numbers -> NEVER silently skipped
families.instead: preference change X instead of Y -> NEVER silently skipped
